job.title: Account Manager or Senior Account Manager
job.description:
Account Manager or Senior Account Manager | Global Creative Agency

About the role:

Recent growth means this agency is expanding it’s team! If you’re an experienced Account Manager with strong integrated creative agency experience, who is looking to take their career to the next level, then this role could be for you. This is a great opportunity to work within a large team across a broad channel mix.

You’ll have the opportunity to take and own your own smaller projects with wider support as well as supporting on large projects. Manage campaigns end to end, working with strategy, creative, right through to production & roll out.

This role will see you working across several types of integrated briefs, from traditional ATL/ brand work to Social, Digital, POS, CX.

About you:

You will be an Account Manager looking for a change or looking to step up to SAM, a proactive self-starter with a friendly and professional approach to your work.

You are fun, personable and a resilient doer, taking pride in anything you do, whilst looking to create and produce the best possible work.

You will have experience with:

  • Managing multiple projects across differing timelines, priorities, and client leads
  • Ability to autonomously manage projects from brief to final delivery with check-ins from an Account Director
  • Ability to think on your feet and proactively seek out answers
  • Creative agency experience

What’s on offer:

  • Flexible hybrid working, 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
  • Join a friendly and down to earth, fun team
  • An agency with good transport links and free parking
  • The opportunity for mentorship from a strong team

This is a rare opportunity to join a global agency at a time of growth!

job.title: Social Content Creator & Designer
job.description:
Social Content Creator | Permanent | Food/Fitness/ Lifestyle brand

Design-led. Visually driven. Social obsessed.

We're looking for a highly creative Social Content Creator who combines strong graphic design skills with hands-on content creation.

This is a hybrid creative role for someone who understands how to build a distinctive visual presence across social platforms — from establishing the look and feel and developing design toolkits, through to shooting and editing engaging video content.

You'll bring a strong eye for design, an instinct for social culture and the ability to take creative ideas from concept through to execution.

What you'll be doing:

  • Shape and evolve the visual look and feel across social channels, ensuring content is distinctive and consistent.
  • Design engaging social assets including graphics, carousels, Stories, campaign creative and paid social content.
  • Develop social content toolkits, including flexible, resizable layouts, templates, text treatments and repeatable content formats.
  • Bring an exceptional eye for typography, composition, colour, imagery and layout to everything you create.
  • Concept, shoot and edit engaging photography and short-form video across food, product and lifestyle content.
  • Create content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and paid social, adapting creative to suit each platform.
  • Explore new formats, trends and AI-assisted creative tools to bring fresh ideas to life.
  • Work with Social, Creative and Marketing teams to deliver high-quality content, using performance insights to continually improve creative output.

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years' experience in graphic design, social content creation or a similar creative role.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing graphic design, social assets, content toolkits, photography and video.
  • An exceptional visual eye, with a strong understanding of typography, composition, colour, imagery and layout.
  • Experience developing design systems, templates and flexible social assets that can be adapted across multiple formats and platforms.
  • The ability to independently concept, shoot and edit engaging photography and video.
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Cloud skills, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator, alongside confident CapCut skills.
  • Confidence using Canva to build adaptable templates; After Effects experience would be a bonus.
  • A strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, including organic and paid social requirements.
  • An interest in emerging trends, AI-assisted creative tools and social culture.
  • A collaborative approach, great organisation and the ability to balance multiple priorities.
  • An interest in food, fitness, nutrition and active lifestyles.

Why you'll love it;

You'll have the opportunity to make your mark on a growing brand, helping shape its visual presence across social while bringing fresh creative ideas to life.
If you're a talented designer and content creator who loves building distinctive visual worlds and creating content that gets people talking, we'd love to see your portfolio

Show us what you can create! Ensure you include a link to your portfolio!

Sheryn Small | Lead Consultant | iknowho.com.au

job.title: PR & Influencer Account Manager
job.description:
PR & Influencer Account Manager | Consumer & Lifestyle |

Are you always one step ahead of the next big thing? Whether it’s the latest restaurant opening, a viral social trend, a must-have fashion label or the next big travel destination, you’re the person in the know.

We’re looking for a PR & Influencer Account Manager with a genuine passion for consumer culture, a sharp creative instinct and the experience to turn trends into stories people want to hear.

The opportunity

You'll work across an exciting portfolio of consumer and lifestyle brands, developing and delivering PR and influencer campaigns that get people talking.
From spotting compelling stories and securing media coverage to identifying the right Influencers & Creators, negotiating partnerships and bringing content to life, you'll play an integral role in creating campaigns that cut through.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years' experience across PR and influencer marketing, ideally working with consumer brands in an agency environment.
  • A genuine passion for social media, culture and lifestyle – from food, to fashion, travel, design and entertainment.
  • Strong media relations skills and a good understanding of the Australian media landscape. You know what makes a great story and how to get it noticed.
  • A solid understanding of the Australian influencer/ creator landscape, and best practise including briefing, negotiating and managing content production.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • The ability to juggle multiple projects, priorities and deadlines without missing a beat.
  • A natural storyteller with creativity, curiosity and plenty of ideas.
  • Experience with PR and influencer tools is a bonus, but not essential.

What's on offer?

  • The opportunity to work with iconic consumer and lifestyle brands across a diverse range of industries.
  • Mentorship from two Account Directors
  • A fun, collaborative team that loves big ideas and bold thinking.
  • A hybrid working environment, with three office days per week.
  • Competitive salary, perks and regular team social events

If you're culturally curious, creatively minded and know how to turn what's happening now into what's next for brands, we'd love to hear from you.

Send your CV and a short cover letter telling us a little about yourself, the experience and capabilities you bring, and your availability.

Sheryn Small | lead Consultant | iknowho.com.au

job.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager | Creative Agency
job.description:
Executive Assistant & Office Manager | Creative Agency | Full-time

The ultimate organiser. The behind-the-scenes powerhouse. The person who makes it all happen. Our client is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant & Office Manager

They're a dynamic, fast-paced creative business, who make great work, deliver big ideas and where no two days are ever quite the same. They need someone who can keep up!
This is a varied, hands-on role combining high-level executive support to the agency founders and ownership of the day-to-day running of the agency. From managing diaries and coordinating travel to keeping the office humming, organising team events and making sure everything is where it needs to be, you'll be across it all.

What you'll be doing:

  • Providing executive support to the two founders, including diary management, meetings, travel and expenses.
  • Keeping the day-to-day operations of the agency running smoothly.
  • Taking ownership of the office environment, suppliers, facilities, equipment and general administration.
  • Coordinating meetings, client visits, catering and agency events.
  • Supporting onboarding, team activities and the little things that make a workplace great.
  • Managing invoices, office budgets and general administration.
  • Being the go-to person for the team and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Spotting what needs doing before anyone has to ask.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in an EA, Office Manager or combined EA/Office Management role.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and an ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • A proactive, can-do attitude. You're a natural problem solver who makes things happen.
  • Confidence communicating with everyone from senior leaders and clients to suppliers and the wider team.
  • Great attention to detail and the ability to think several steps ahead.
  • Someone who is comfortable working autonomously and taking ownership.
  • A positive, personable nature and a great sense of humour.
  • Flexibility, initiative and a willingness to roll up your sleeves.

The kind of person we're after:

 You're the person everyone relies on. You're organised without being rigid, professional without being corporate and can switch seamlessly between managing an executive's calendar, sorting out a last-minute request and organising the next team celebration.

You thrive on variety, enjoy being around creative people and take genuine pride in making things run effortlessly behind the scenes.
If you're resourceful, energetic, love a challenge and want to be part of a creative business where there's always something happening, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and make yourself indispensable.

Sheryn Small | Lead Talent Partner | iknowho.com.au
